paragraphs.text: Bojuka Bay is a swampy mangrove bay of on the continent of Bala Ged on Zendikar .

Bojuka Bay is less a bay and more a giant marsh that developed inside the Guum Wilds. Initially, an inlet, the prolific flora of the Guum Wilds had overtaken the water, creating a vast swampy region. The Bojuka Bay serves as the mouth of the Umung River and is home to fearsome marsh trolls as well as the Grotag goblins . A sea route into the Bay, called the Bojuka Route , was opened after twenty years of preparation, but was forced to close after a single year.
Bojuka once was part of the ancient Makindi Empire. The elven nations, led by a pre-spirit Obuun , revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave .
Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi , the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed.
After Nissa Revane 's use of the healing power of the Lithoform Core , the bay and the rest of the continent slowly started to recover.
